_readme: Tier-2 budgets and reset windows for lane_pick.py. Tier-1 lanes (opus, fable,
codex-sol, codex-terra) read a real utilization percentage from local state and
budget      what you are willing to spend in one window, in the lane's own unit
(grok: API-equivalent USD · glm: plan prompts · gemini: model calls)
window_days length of the window; 7 unless a vendor says otherwise
reset_epoch optional. A fixed reset instant, if the vendor has one. Omit for a
rolling window and the full window is treated as the time remaining.
api         optional. Wire a real quota endpoint when one exists to point at:
Nothing is wired by default and that is deliberate — see
references/usage-sources.md for why guessing a URL is worse than
Delete the lanes block entirely to fall back to the calibrated defaults.
